fireants.implementation: pinned native SyNRegistration and native warp composition
fireants.recipe: native SyN defaults with an explicit generic multiresolution schedule
limitations: published speed reproduction is unverified; actual fused/fallback backend is recorded per run

convexadam.recipe: public API defaults, inverse consistency and Adam enabled
limitations: self-configuration search and dataset-selected settings were not reproduced
published leaderboard reproduction is not claimed

ccidir.implementation: pinned native ImplicitRegistrator.fit and second-order consensus
ccidir.recipe: 2500 iterations and static cycle weight; 50 fits per DIR-Lab case with both directions scored
limitations: mask equality with authors' original masks is not established
numeric random seed IDs were not published; we record IDs 0..49

nir.implementation: pinned native single-field Gaussian/SIREN and train_efficient_pairwise
nir.recipe: released-code adaptation: MSE plus Jacobian 10, learning rate 0.0002, 3000 steps
limitations: not the paper's hybrid two-field recipe
paper single-field budget, learning rate and regularization differ
native inference maxlen conversion is preserved even though dataio's inverse helper differs
independent input minmax is an explicit adaptation
